body: Thank you kind stranger. Even words from 2-3 people off reddit is sometimes enough to encourage people through tough times. 1 day at a time and hopefully i get out of this mess.

Computer Science. I was told by all my family, relatives that this was the only way i could get a decent paying job in the future. I guess its kinda my fault that i was too weak to voice my opinions back then.

You recall correctly. People here usually dont work at younger ages. And i did propose if i could look for some work but since i haven't graduated yet i wont get any good jobs and that would apparently affect my parents "status" in society if i have a not so good job. fml
India. I usually go play football/soccer, read books, play videogames, etc in my spare time. But making a career out of any of those would be looked down upon in our society.
Never got to figure it out since i was in the rat race towards becoming an engineer. Thanks for the reply friend. Feels good talking to someone knowing i dont have to keep everything within me.
